title: CrownThrive External MCP Certification Exit Plan

source_authority.caveat: The official conformance framework has a documented open issue in which the final 2026-07-28 release can still be treated as draft for tier arithmetic. Official-suite output is therefore necessary evidence but not sufficient by itself; CrownThrive overlay tests remain mandatory.

required_sequence: bind the certification run to the exact canonical main SHA and active Edge deployment digest
apply only the pre-reviewed v4.1.0 conformance repairs
run the CrownThrive overlay negative/positive suite from an external client runner
run the applicable official MCP 2026-07-28 server conformance suite and preserve raw results
perform at most one D0 CrownThrive IO tool call and one D0 ThriveTools SEO tool call for real structuredContent proof
verify provider writes remain disabled and no non-D0 central tool is exposed
verify request audit records the bounded live reads
independently review Security/Privacy and Operations/SRE evidence
move external_client_conformance_test to PASS only if every mandatory acceptance predicate is proven
keep Phase 3 blocked unless the separate Phase 2.99 hard exit and full-documentation gate also pass

mandatory_acceptance.claim: server/discover succeeds under protocol 2026-07-28 and returns tools capability plus private cache metadata
tools/list is deterministic, bounded to the governed central dispatch surface, and advertises valid JSON Schema 2020-12 input/output schemas
malformed MCP JSON returns JSON-RPC ParseError -32700 with null id
non-application/json MCP POST is rejected with HTTP 415 before body parsing
required MCP routing headers are checked against the JSON-RPC body and mismatch returns -32020
unsupported protocol version returns -32022 with the supported protocol list
unknown method returns JSON-RPC -32601 using the final 2026-07-28 transport semantics
all enabled central input schemas reject undeclared properties and preserve only documented bounded parameters
all enabled central output schemas are bounded operation-specific contracts and successful structuredContent validates against them
runtime endpoint catalog revocation is fail-closed at dispatch time
inbound and provider response bytes are bounded before full buffering and provider requests have explicit cancellation deadlines
provider success requires successful JSON parsing and least-data projection; malformed provider JSON cannot be surfaced as a successful tool result
at least one real D0 tool call per dispatchable provider succeeds through the external MCP client and creates durable request evidence
zero provider mutation tools and zero non-D0 central tools are exposed during certification
official MCP conformance output and CrownThrive overlay output are attached to the exact runtime/head evidence envelope

founder_signature.effect: Authorizes only the final certification implementation and bounded external live execution described in this exact artifact. It does not authorize provider writes, non-D0 tool enablement, commercial acceptance, constitutional changes, or Phase 3 advancement.
